project.name: Games of Legends
project.summary: Games of Legends: 'The home of League of Legends competitive statistics' with pro game statistics; sections Tournaments, Teams, Players, Champions, Plays, Tools and Premium, plus search by team, player or champion.

about.text: Games of Legends: 'The home of League of Legends competitive statistics' with pro game statistics; sections Tournaments, Teams, Players, Champions, Plays, Tools and Premium, plus search by team, player or champion.

tests.inputs: fact as shown: Worlds 2026 Main Event: Number of games 76; page url: https://gol.gg/tournament/tournament-stats/Worlds%202026%20Main%20Event/
tests.expected: 76 main-event games = 98 total (LeagueRecords, RiftWise) - 22 play-in games

tests.inputs: fact as shown: Worlds 2014: Number of games 78; page url: https://gol.gg/tournament/tournament-stats/World%20Championship%202014/
fact as shown: Worlds 2019: main event 77 + play-in 43 games; page url: https://gol.gg/tournament/tournament-stats/World%20Championship%202019/ and ...Play-In%202019/
fact as shown: Worlds 2025 Main Event: Number of games 80; page url: https://gol.gg/tournament/tournament-stats/Worlds%202025%20Main%20Event/
tests.expected: 84 total (LeagueRecords) = 80 + one best-of-5 play-in match (4 games per Wikipedia 'one best-of-5 play-in match')

tests.inputs: fact as shown: Draft mode labels: Worlds 2025 and 2026 'Fearless Draft'; 2014/2019/S3 'Classic'; page url: https://gol.gg/tournament/tournament-stats/Worlds%202026%20Main%20Event/
tests.expected: Fearless Draft used at Worlds 2025 and 2026; classic before

tests.inputs: fact as shown: Worlds 2014 longest game '71:34 - Group C - Fnatic vs OMG'; page url: https://gol.gg/tournament/tournament-stats/World%20Championship%202014/
tests.expected: 71 min 34 s, Fnatic vs Oh My God, Group C, Worlds 2014

tests.inputs: fact as shown: Worlds 2026 Top KDA: Knight 9.2 (87/26/151), Faker 7.2 (51/19/85), Canyon 5.8 (48/32/137); page url: https://gol.gg/tournament/tournament-stats/Worlds%202026%20Main%20Event/
fact as shown: Worlds 2026 shortest game 23:51 HLE vs Top Esports; most kills Zeka 17; page url: https://gol.gg/tournament/tournament-stats/Worlds%202026%20Main%20Event/
tests.expected: StatChecked: shortest 23.9 min (HLE), best single-player kills 17

tests.inputs: fact as shown: Quick Access label 'LPL 2026 Regional Finals' for the 2026 LPL playoffs; page url: https://gol.gg/esports/home/
tests.expected: RiftWise calls it 'LPL 2026 Grand Finals'; Wikipedia: Anyone's Legend won the 2026 title
tests.actual: naming differs between sites (both refer to the same event)

tests.inputs: fact as shown: Claim (about): 'I started Games of Legends in 2014'; tournament list tabs S3-S16; page url: https://gol.gg/tournament/list/
tests.expected: Seasons from 2013 (S3) onward; Worlds S3 page present (63 games), 2014, 2019, 2025, 2026 present
tests.actual: S3 to S16 only; 2011-2012 absent but never claimed; 5 of 5 sampled Worlds pages present and complete; no stated coverage claim to test
